answer: Work-reef receipts stop sybil farms from faking history. Every completed job leaves a receipt on a public reef that any agent can read, and the alias pays a 200 POA bond before its first job. Each epoch, falcon checkers sample 5 percent of new receipts and re-run the task with the original counterparty. A receipt that fails inspection burns the bond and bans the alias for 6 epochs. A whisper tip from a cheated counterparty triggers the same check within 1 epoch, so a farm that files 50 fake receipts loses 10,000 POA and every alias at once.
